remarks: Expanded and fully renovated in 2005, this exceptional Colonial is located in the prestigious Hoyt Farm neighborhood, close to the village. Set on two acres of beautifully landscaped property, the home features five bedrooms and five and a half baths, offering a perfect blend of sophistication and comfort. The main floor welcomes you with a dramatic two-story foyer, an open chef's kitchen flowing seamlessly into the spacious family room, a breakfast room, formal living room with French doors to the backyard, formal dining room, a custom mahogany library, a separate den with fireplace with views of the pool, and a spacious mudroom with a separate entrance. Upstairs, a serene primary bedroom suite with fireplace, private balcony overlooking the pool, a spa-like bath, and a large walk-in closet. Four additional bedrooms, three full baths plus a study room complete this level. A separate back staircase leads to a private office and large bonus room with full bath, ideal for working from home or using as an in-law or au pair suite. The walkup third floor is finished as an exercise room. Outside, enjoy the tranquil stone terrace, stunning gunite heated pool with complete privacy and beautiful mature landscaping and specimen trees - perfect for enjoying the outdoors. House enjoys benefits of solar panels and 50% reduction in electricity costs. 3-car garage and plenty of storage throughout. All this within minutes of the train and part of a vibrant community with top-rated schools.
